CHECK ((((low_price IS NULL) OR (low_price >= (0)::numeric)) AND ((mid_price IS NULL) OR (mid_price >= (0)::numeric)) AND ((high_price IS NULL) OR (high_price >= (0)::numeric)) AND ((direct_low_price IS NULL) OR (direct_low_price >= (0)::numeric))))
FOREIGN KEY (card_print_id) REFERENCES card_prints(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (card_printing_id) REFERENCES card_printings(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK ((((decision = 'publish'::text) AND (publication_lane = 'current'::text) AND (freshness_result = 'fresh'::text) AND (eligible = true) AND (cardinality(reason_codes) = 0)) OR ((decision <> 'publish'::text) AND (publication_lane <> 'current'::text) AND (eligible = false) AND (cardinality(reason_codes) > 0))))
FOREIGN KEY (phase_attempt_id) REFERENCES market_price_pipeline_phase_attempts(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

FOREIGN KEY (batch_id) REFERENCES mtg_canonical_import_batches(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (((asking_price_currency IS NULL) OR ((asking_price_currency = upper(asking_price_currency)) AND (char_length(asking_price_currency) = 3))))
FOREIGN KEY (card_printing_id) REFERENCES card_printings(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
CHECK (((gv_vi_id IS NULL) OR ((btrim(gv_vi_id) <> ''::text) AND (gv_vi_id = upper(btrim(gv_vi_id))))))
CHECK (((((card_print_id IS NOT NULL))::integer + ((slab_cert_id IS NOT NULL))::integer) = 1))

CHECK ((((pricing_mode = 'market'::text) AND (asking_price_amount IS NULL) AND (asking_price_currency IS NULL) AND (asking_price_note IS NULL)) OR ((pricing_mode = 'asking'::text) AND (asking_price_amount IS NOT NULL) AND (asking_price_currency IS NOT NULL))))
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
